newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kemet raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kemet raised to buy.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane analyst Dimitri Triantafyllides said he upgraded semiconductor maker Kemet Corp to buy from neutral.
-- In published comments, the analyst said he set a 12- to 18-month price target of $30 on Kemet. It closed at 20-3/8 Wednesday.

-- He said he was cutting his earnings estimate for the fourth quarter ending March 1997 by $0.02, to $0.35 a share, thereby reducing his full-year estimate to $1.16. He called this "fine-tuning." He intitiated a fiscal 1998 estimate of $1.55 a share.

-- Triantafyllides said he believes the bottom of the industrywide inventory correction was reached in the June quarter and that "the stock at current levels represents a compelling valuation opportunity with a very favorable risk/return relationship."
